detail.longDescription: Retina-PE combined retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors and mean arterial pressure using data from 8,616 pregnancies. External-validation AUCs ranged from 0.728 to 0.815 across prediction tasks. The retrospective analysis of prospectively collected Chinese cohorts supports further testing, but does not show improved maternal or neonatal outcomes. Retinal AI Predicted Preeclampsia Across 8,616 Pregnancies, but Performance Varied by Window
